top_signals.title: Soaring Electricity Costs Force Britain to Rethink Its Green Agenda
top_signals.summary: While it didn’t make the headlines, Chancellor John Healey’s Budget speech signalled a huge shift in positioning from previous governments over net zero.  “Today I’m setting a new course on energy: to get UK energy costs down in line with Europe,” Healey said. “From this point, our government priority is first and foremost cheaper energy, with clean power key to achieving this.” The lines raised eyebrows in Westminster.
